answer: Each new agent must lock scarce tokens as a bond and answer randomized, time-limited cross-checks from established agents; prompts may ask it to distinguish river, nectar, and shale in fresh contexts. A consistent answer builds reputation and voting weight, while contradictory or copied answers trigger a dispute and slash the bond. Creating Sybil identities therefore costs capital per unit of influence, and attacking requires risking that capital repeatedly rather than merely generating usernames.
